shared.tagline.text: Hu twɛn bere no ansa na wobɛhyɛn.

shared.footer.copyright.en: © 2026 PickupRadar. Independent and not affiliated with Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat.
shared.footer.copyright.text: © 2026 PickupRadar. Ɛgyina ne ho so, na enni Uber Eats, Deliveroo anaa Just Eat ho.

shared.scale.estimate.en: No recent reports? PickupRadar may show {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}:
shared.scale.estimate.text: Amanneɛbɔ foforo nni hɔ? PickupRadar betumi akyerɛ {likelyFast} anaa {likelySlow}:

home.meta.title.en: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): pickup wait times for delivery drivers in the UK
home.meta.title.text: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): pickup twɛn bere ma akarfoɔ wɔ United Kingdom

home.meta.description.en: See how long drivers wait at restaurants and shops before you go in. For Uber Eats, Deliveroo and Just Eat drivers in the UK. No sign-up needed.
home.meta.description.text: Hwɛ sɛnea akarfoɔ twɛn wɔ adidibea ne sotɔɔ mu ansa na wobɛhyɛn. Ma Uber Eats, Deliveroo ne Just Eat akarfoɔ wɔ United Kingdom. Wɔnhyɛ wo din.

home.meta.imageAlt.en: PickupRadar. Know the wait before you walk in.
home.meta.imageAlt.text: PickupRadar. Hu twɛn bere no ansa na wobɛhyɛn.

home.hero.lede.en: Do you deliver for Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat? See recent pickup waits at restaurants and shops. Avoid long waits. Tap {reportWait} and earn {radarPoints}. No sign-up needed.
home.hero.lede.text: Wode nneɛma kɔ ma Uber Eats, Deliveroo anaa Just Eat? Hwɛ twɛn bere foforo wɔ adidibea ne sotɔɔ pickup beae. Kwati twɛn tenten. Mia {reportWait} na nya {radarPoints}. Wɔnhyɛ wo din.

home.hero.cities.en: Now in Milton Keynes. London is next.
home.hero.cities.text: Seesei wɔ Milton Keynes. Akyiri no London.

home.hero.apps.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon.
home.hero.apps.text: iPhone ne Android app no reba ntɛm.

home.example.aria.en: Example PickupRadar Home screen with the {nearby} tab open, showing pickup points coloured by their wait
home.example.aria.text: PickupRadar fie skreen nhwɛso, tab {nearby} abue. Pickup beae no wɔ kɔla sɛnea twɛn bere no te

home.example.banner.en: Example screen: sample waits, not live driver reports
home.example.banner.text: Nhwɛso skreen: twɛn bere nhwɛso, ɛnyɛ akarfo amanneɛbɔ a ɛreyɛ

home.example.caption.en: Example screen. These are sample wait times, not live reports. {live} with real data.
home.example.caption.text: Nhwɛso skreen. Eyi yɛ twɛn bere nhwɛso, ɛnyɛ amanneɛbɔ a ɛreyɛ. {live} nokware nsɛm.

home.try.tab.en: {lead} Use {nearby} to find pickup points close to you when location is on. Use {fast} and {slow} to check waits and estimates.
home.try.tab.text: {lead} Fa {nearby} di dwuma hwehwɛ pickup beae a ɛbɛn wo bere a beae no ayɛ. Fa {fast} ne {slow} di dwuma hwɛ twɛn bere ne nsusui.

home.try.search.en: {lead} Try a name, area or postcode, like KFC or Bletchley.
home.try.search.text: {lead} Sɔ din, mpɔtam anaa post koodu hwɛ, te sɛ KFC anaa Bletchley.

home.try.open.en: {lead} The {reportWait} screen opens. Choose a wait time. Nothing is sent.
home.try.open.text: {lead} {reportWait} skreen no bue. Paw twɛn bere. Biribiara nkɔ.

home.signals.title.en: What you can see before you go in

home.signals.intro.en: You see the same labels in the app. Drivers report them, not the delivery apps.
home.signals.intro.text: Wohu nkyerɛwde koro no ara wɔ app no mu. Akarfoɔ na wɔbɔ ho amanneɛ, ɛnyɛ delivery app no.

home.signals.current.body.en: Drivers choose a wait time. You see the current wait and how many drivers reported it in the last 2 hours.
home.signals.current.body.text: Akarfoɔ paw twɛn bere no. Wohu twɛn bere a ɛwɔ hɔ seesei ne akarfoɔ dodow a wɔabɔ ho amanneɛ wɔ nnɔnhwerew 2 a atwam mu.

home.signals.likely.body.en: Shown only when there are no recent reports. These are estimates, not live reports.
home.signals.likely.body.text: Wɔkyerɛ wɔ bere a amanneɛbɔ foforo nni hɔ nko ara. Eyi yɛ nsusui, ɛnyɛ amanneɛbɔ a ɛreyɛ.

home.signals.closed.pill.text: Wɔabɔ amanneɛ seesei ara sɛ wɔato mu

home.signals.closed.body.en: Drivers tap {reportProblem} to report this. You see their report before you drive there.
home.signals.closed.body.text: Akarfoɔ mia {reportProblem} de bɔ eyi ho amanneɛ. Wohu amanneɛbɔ no ansa na wobɛkɔ hɔ.

home.signals.missing.title.text: Pickup beae a ayera anaa a ɛnyɛ

home.how.intro.en: Three easy steps. Reporting takes a few seconds.
home.how.intro.text: Anammɔn mmiɛnsa a ɛyɛ mmerɛw. Amanneɛbɔ no gye simma kakra.

home.how.step1.body.en: No password. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You don't need to sign up.
home.how.step1.body.text: Password nni hɔ. App no ma wo Radar profael ankasa. Ɛnsɛ sɛ wohyɛ wo din.

home.how.step2.body.en: Find the pickup point. See the current wait, or {likelyFast} or {likelySlow} if there are no recent reports.
home.how.step2.body.text: Hwehwɛ pickup beae no. Hwɛ twɛn bere a ɛwɔ hɔ seesei, anaa {likelyFast} anaa {likelySlow} sɛ amanneɛbɔ foforo nni hɔ a.

home.how.step3.title.text: Bɔ wo twɛn bere ho amanneɛ

home.how.step3.body.en: After you collect the order, tap {reportWait}. It takes seconds. Your report helps other drivers, and you earn {radarPoints}.
home.how.step3.body.text: Bere a wogye hyɛ no awie no, mia {reportWait}. Ɛgye simma kakra. Wo amanneɛbɔ no boa akarfoɔ foforo, na wunya {radarPoints}.

home.points.neededHelp.en: An eligible pickup point near you with no recent wait and no {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}. You earn 15 RP for the report instead of 10.
home.points.neededHelp.text: Pickup beae a ɛfata a ɛbɛn wo, twɛn bere foforo nni hɔ, na {likelyFast} anaa {likelySlow} nni hɔ. Wonya 15 RP wɔ saa amanneɛbɔ no ho, ɛnyɛ 10.

home.cities.body.en: These are the UK cities in the app. Can't find your city? Request it in the app. Or tap {notify} on a {comingSoon} city. We'll email you when it's live.
home.cities.body.text: Eyinom ne United Kingdom nkuro a ɛwɔ app no mu. Wunhu wo kurow? Bisa wɔ app no mu. Anaa mia {notify} wɔ kurow a ɛyɛ {comingSoon} so. Yɛbɛsoma email bere a ɛba ase.

home.trust.title.en: Not part of any delivery app

home.trust.body.en: PickupRadar is independent. It is not part of Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or any other delivery app. It never uses your accounts with them.
home.trust.body.text: PickupRadar gyina ne ho so. Ɛnyɛ Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat anaa delivery app foforo biara fa. Ɛmfa wo akontaabu a ɛwɔ hɔ no nni dwuma da.

home.trust.login.en: {lead} We never ask for your Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat username or password.
home.trust.login.text: {lead} Yɛmmisa Uber Eats, Deliveroo anaa Just Eat din anaa password da.

home.trust.detailsLead.text: Dɛtɔfo anaa hyɛ ho nsɛm nni hɔ.

home.trust.details.en: {lead} No names, addresses or order numbers.
home.trust.details.text: {lead} Din, adrɛse anaa hyɛ nɔma nni hɔ.

home.faq.account.a.en: No. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You can report waits straight away. To protect your {radarPoints}, add your email later. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
home.faq.account.a.text: Dabi. App no ma wo Radar profael ankasa. Wubetumi abɔ twɛn bere ho amanneɛ ntɛm ara. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wobɔ {radarPoints} ho ban a, fa email ka ho akyiri. Password nni hɔ. App no soma nɔma 6 koodu wɔ email so.

home.faq.download.q.en: When can I download the app?
home.faq.download.q.text: Bere bɛn na mɛtumi atwe app no?

home.faq.download.a.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon. For now, the {preview} shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits.
home.faq.download.a.text: iPhone ne Android app no reba ntɛm. Seesei, {preview} kyerɛ pickup beae ankasa ne twɛn bere wɔ Milton Keynes.

home.faq.track.a.en: No background tracking. The app uses your location while you use it, to show nearby pickup points and check you are at a pickup point when reporting. The website asks for location only when you choose to use it. Read the {privacy} for more.
home.faq.track.a.text: Akyi akyidifoɔ nni hɔ. App no de wo beae di dwuma bere a wode reyɛ adwuma, de kyerɛ pickup beae a ɛbɛn wo na hwɛ sɛ wowɔ pickup beae no so bere a worebɔ amanneɛ. Saet no bisa beae no bere a wopaw sɛ wode bɛyɛ adwuma nko ara. Kenkan {privacy} na hu pii.

app.meta.description.en: Try the PickupRadar app with real Milton Keynes data. Look around, search for pickup points and see the report screen.
app.meta.description.text: Sɔ PickupRadar app no hwɛ a Milton Keynes nokware nsɛm wom. Hwɛ ho, hwehwɛ pickup beae na hwɛ amanneɛbɔ skreen no.

app.hero.lede.en: This is PickupRadar with real Milton Keynes data. Look around. Search for a pickup point and open it. Nothing you tap here is sent. You can only report in the mobile app.
app.hero.lede.text: Eyi ne PickupRadar a Milton Keynes nokware nsɛm wom. Hwɛ ho. Hwehwɛ pickup beae na bue. Biribiara a womia wɔ ha nkɔ. Wubetumi abɔ amanneɛ wɔ fon app no mu nko ara.

app.preview.aria.en: Full PickupRadar app preview with real Milton Keynes data
app.preview.aria.text: PickupRadar app hwɛ a emu nyinaa a Milton Keynes nokware nsɛm wom

support.meta.description.en: Get help with PickupRadar: contact support, report a pickup point problem, and find answers about your Radar profile, {radarPoints} and deleting your account.
support.meta.description.text: PickupRadar mmoa: frɛ mmoa, bɔ pickup beae ɔhaw ho amanneɛ, na hwehwɛ mmuae fa Radar profael, {radarPoints} ne akontaabu popa ho.

support.hero.lede.en: Need help? Email us about the app, a pickup point, your {radarPoints} or your privacy.
support.hero.lede.text: Wohia mmoa? Soma email fa app no, pickup beae, {radarPoints} anaa wo kokoam ho.

support.contact.body.en: Email us for help, ideas, pickup point problems or privacy questions:
support.contact.body.text: Soma email ma mmoa, adwene, pickup beae ɔhaw anaa kokoam nsɛmmisa:

support.address.note.en: For letters only. Email is the fastest way to reach us.
support.address.note.text: Ma krataa nko ara. Email ne kwan a ɛyɛ ntɛm a wode bɛfrɛ yɛn.

support.include.body.en: If you report a problem, please tell us:
support.include.body.text: Sɛ worebɔ ɔhaw ho amanneɛ a, ka kyerɛ yɛn:

support.include.area.en: The area or postcode, if you know it
support.include.area.text: Mpɔtam anaa post koodu, sɛ wonim a

support.include.phone.en: Your phone model, if the app has a problem
support.include.phone.text: Wo fon nhyehyɛe, sɛ ɔhaw no wɔ app no mu a

support.topics.profile.body.en: The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You do not need to log in to use PickupRadar or earn {radarPoints}. Adding your email is optional. It protects your {radarPoints} if you change or reset your phone. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
support.topics.profile.body.text: App no ma wo Radar profael ankasa. Ɛnsɛ sɛ wokɔ mu na wode PickupRadar bedi dwuma anaa wubenya {radarPoints}. Email a wode ka ho yɛ nea wopɛ. Ɛbɔ {radarPoints} ho ban sɛ wosesa anaa wosiesie fon no bio a. Password nni hɔ. App no soma nɔma 6 koodu wɔ email so.

support.topics.points.body.en: You earn {radarPoints} for valid wait reports ({waitRp}, or {neededRp} when it says {reportNeeded}), a first report bonus ({firstRp}) and pickup points we approve ({approvedRp}). You can invite a driver from {profile}. You both need protected Radar accounts (add your email). Your friend enters your code before their first valid wait report. When your friend makes 3 valid wait reports, on at least 2 different days (UTC time), at 2 different pickup points, you each earn {referralRp}. {rewards} You can't redeem {radarPoints} yet.
support.topics.points.body.text: Wonya {radarPoints} wɔ twɛn amanneɛbɔ a ɛfata ho ({waitRp}, anaa {neededRp} bere a wɔakyerɛw {reportNeeded}), amanneɛbɔ a edi kan no bɔnas ({firstRp}) ne pickup beae a yɛpene so ({approvedRp}). Wubetumi afrɛ akarfo fi {profile}. Mo baanu hia Radar akontaabu a wɔabɔ ho ban (fa email ka ho). Wo adamfo kyerɛw wo koodu no ansa na twɛn amanneɛbɔ a edi kan a ɛfata no aba. Bere a wo adamfo yɛ twɛn amanneɛbɔ a ɛfata 3, wɔ nna 2 soronko so koraa (UTC bere), wɔ pickup beae 2 soronko so no, biara nya {referralRp}. {rewards} Wuntumi mfa {radarPoints} nni dwuma seesei.

support.topics.messages.body.en: {profile} has {messages}: announcements, alerts and personal messages for your city or Radar profile. Old or removed messages may no longer appear.
support.topics.messages.body.text: {profile} wɔ {messages}: nkratoɔ, kɔkɔbɔ ne ankasa nkrasɛm ma wo kurow anaa wo Radar profael. Nkrasɛm dadaw anaa nea wɔayi no betumi ammra bio.

support.topics.delete.body.en: Delete your account in the app: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Or email {email}. If you did not add an email, the app shows {deleteProfile} instead. See the {page} page for the steps.
support.topics.delete.body.text: Popa akontaabu no wɔ app no mu: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Anaa soma email kɔ {email}. Sɛ woamfa email anka ho a, app no kyerɛ {deleteProfile}. Hwɛ krataafa {page} na hu anammɔn no.

support.topics.missing.body.en: Is a pickup point missing? Tap {suggest} in the app. Is one wrong? Tap {reportProblem}. Or email us and we will check it.
support.topics.missing.body.text: Pickup beae no nni hɔ? Mia {suggest} wɔ app no mu. Biribi nyɛ yiye? Mia {reportProblem}. Anaa soma email na yɛbɛhwɛ.

support.topics.delivery.body.en: PickupRadar does not connect to your Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or other delivery app accounts. We never ask for your delivery app logins, passwords, account details, customer details or order details. Drivers only share pickup reports, like wait times and pickup point problems.
support.topics.delivery.body.text: PickupRadar nni wo Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat anaa delivery app foforo akontaabu ho. Yɛmmisa kɔ mu, password, akontaabu nsɛm, dɛtɔfo nsɛm anaa hyɛ nsɛm da. Akarfoɔ kyɛ pickup amanneɛbɔ nko ara, te sɛ twɛn bere ne pickup beae ɔhaw.

support.closer.title.en: Try PickupRadar before the app launches.
support.closer.title.text: Sɔ PickupRadar hwɛ ansa na app no aba.

support.closer.body.en: The live preview shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits. Reporting and {radarPoints} are only in the mobile app.
support.closer.body.text: Hwɛ a ɛreyɛ no kyerɛ pickup beae ankasa ne twɛn bere wɔ Milton Keynes. Amanneɛbɔ ne {radarPoints} wɔ fon app no mu nko ara.

notfound.meta.description.en: That page is not on the PickupRadar website.
notfound.meta.description.text: Saa krataafa no nni PickupRadar saet no so.

notfound.title.en: This page is off the radar.
notfound.title.text: Saa krataafa yi wɔ radar akyi.

notfound.body.en: That address isn't on the PickupRadar website. These pages are:
notfound.body.text: Saa adrɛse no nni PickupRadar saet no so. Krataafa yi wɔ hɔ:
